pipeline.train module¶

Training Utilities for NGLab.

Provides high-level functions for rolling out models, training epochs, and handling gradient clipping.

pipeline.train.clip_grad_norms(param_groups, max_norm=inf)[source]¶

Clips the norms for all param groups to max_norm and returns gradient norms before clipping :param optimizer: :param max_norm: :param gradient_norms_log: :return: grad_norms, clipped_grad_norms: list with (clipped) gradient norms per group

pipeline.train.rollout(model, dataset, opts)[source]¶

Perform evaluation rollout on a dataset.

Parameters:

  • model (nn.Module) – The model to evaluate.

  • dataset (Dataset) – The dataset to roll out on.

  • opts (Dict) – Evaluation options.

Returns:

Concatenated results from the rollout.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

pipeline.train_ppo module¶

PPO Training Script for Trading Environment

This script trains a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent on the Rust-backed TradingEnv using Stable-Baselines3.

pipeline.train_ppo.make_env(rank: int, seed: int = 0, lookback: int = 30, max_steps: int = 1000)[source]¶

Create a TradingEnv instance.

pipeline.train_ppo.train_ppo(args)[source]¶

Train a PPO agent on TradingEnv.

pipeline.train_sac module¶

SAC Training Script for Trading Environment

This script trains a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent on the Rust-backed TradingEnv using Stable-Baselines3.

NOTE: SAC requires a continuous action space. TradingEnv uses Discrete(3). This script uses a custom wrapper to convert the discrete space to continuous.

class pipeline.train_sac.ContinuousActionWrapper(env)[source]¶

Bases: ActionWrapper

Wrapper to convert discrete action space to continuous. Maps a continuous action in [-1, 1] to discrete {0, 1, 2}.

action(action)[source]¶

Convert continuous action to discrete.

pipeline.train_sac.make_env(rank: int, seed: int = 0, lookback: int = 30, max_steps: int = 1000)[source]¶

Create a wrapped TradingEnv instance for SAC.

Train a SAC agent on TradingEnv.
